source_semantics.review: Do not wholesale adopt this mixed CDK runtime and zoneless test migration. Runtime MenuBase changes focus state to a signal/computed tabindex and TreeNode adds ChangeDetectorRef expansion notifications without adding teardown in this patch. Those exact operations are individually bounded; all other runtime AST operations remain equal after removing only the reviewed import/member frames. The owned product imports neither CDK menu nor tree and contains no fork of those classes. Test preparation changes are substantive: four focus-trap cases hide a region instead of destroying the fixture, table/tree error cases remove catch/flush wrappers, fixtures add marks/renders and source subscriptions, and one exact autofill callback moves to a new zone-specific standalone fixture. All 219 cases survive, with 161 equal complete callbacks including the move, but provider, notification, error and destruction semantics are not proved equivalent. Retain historical fixture/lifetime/error contracts and explicit zoneful bootstrap; no CDK fork or modern test replacement.
